mechanism: Diltiazem inhibits CYP3A4, which metabolizes mefloquine, increasing mefloquine levels and cardiotoxicity risk; mefloquine also has inherent cardiac effects that are potentiated by diltiazem's negative inotropic and chronotropic properties.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, monitor cardiac function closely with ECG and consider alternative antimalarial or alternative to diltiazem; dose adjustment of mefloquine may be required.
